# Button

Pill-shaped CTA button, use for any primary or secondary action; one primary (brand gradient) per view.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Button` · Core

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Button>…</AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Button">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Aleem CTA button: `primary` carries the AA-safe blue→cyan gradient (`--gradient-brand-deep`). Hover tints, keyboard focus shows a ring, press scales to 0.97. Use one primary per view.

## Props (ButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'ink' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'danger' \| 'dangerGhost' \| 'onInk' \| 'onInkSolid'` | Visual style. @default "primary" |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | Control size. @default "md" |
| `iconStart` | `React.ReactNode` | Node before the label (inline-start: left in LTR, right in RTL). Preferred over iconLeft. |
| `iconEnd` | `React.ReactNode` | Node after the label (inline-end). Preferred over iconRight. |
| `iconLeft` | `React.ReactNode` | Alias of iconStart, kept for compatibility. |
| `iconRight` | `React.ReactNode` | Alias of iconEnd, kept for compatibility. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Stretch to fill the container width. @default false |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Show a spinner and block interaction. Under reduced motion: static dots + visible label. @default false |
| `loadingLabel` | `string` | Screen-reader text while loading. @default "Loading" |
| `href` | `string` | Render as an anchor pointing here (keeps button styling). |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |

_Also accepts: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>._
